citation_coverage.rationale: Provides file paths and line spans for the located test, each assertion, and each implementation step; negative assertions refer to the fully visible test body.

citation_entailment.rationale: The read slices contain the test's exact assertions and the non-chain invocation sequence. The Command.invoke slice corroborates the group callback interpretation.

source_authority.rationale: Uses actual repository test and implementation reads, not external documentation or another version.

tool_navigation.rationale: Visible evidence consists of searches and bounded source reads containing all relevant lines; no test-execution claim is made.

uncertainty.rationale: Explicitly distinguishes source inspection from execution and test assertions from generalizations.

unsupported_extras.rationale: The complete test body supports the stated absence of exit-code, return-value, hierarchy, parameter-forwarding, sibling-resolution, and result-callback assertions. No unsupported broader runtime guarantee is offered.

usability.rationale: Clearly separates test location, both invocation paths, implementation order, and limitations while providing the requested citations.

units.rationale: Locates the correct existing test and explains that the invoke_without_command group manually invokes sync when invoked_subcommand is None. The complete test is visible in the read slice.
